title: Kähler complexity one Hamiltonian $T$-manifolds have trivial paintings
summary: Let a torus $T$ act on a symplectic manifold $(M,ω)$ with moment map $φ$. We say that the Hamiltonian $T$-manifold $(M,ω,φ)$ has complexity one if $\frac{1}{2} \dim M - \dim T = 1$, and that it is Kähler if it admits an invariant compatible complex structure. In this paper, we show how the class of Kähler complexity one Hamiltonian $T$-manifolds sits inside the class of complexity one Hamiltonian $T$-manifolds by proving that every compact, connected Kähler complexity one Hamiltonian $T$-manifold has a trivial painting.
